'''Jebbis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Jebbis worked in the [[Fungus Pit]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the settlement of [[Bashka]], on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. He was employed as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]], along with the Besalisks [[Dovoul]] and [[Gatwer]], and was armed with a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. He was present in the cantina when it was attacked by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Noric Gestal]] and a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].
